name: shell-hygiene
description: Blocks shell commands that reach past what the agent started or created: processes by pattern, and machine-wide installs, prunes, services and settings. Complements CC Safety Net's built-in rm and find rules. The why and the alternatives live in the shell-hygiene-* skills in nhooey/shell-skills. A rule whose block_args holds the command's own name blocks every call to it. Gaps: `sudo` is analyzed as a wrapper and can't be blocked here, `kill $(pgrep -f ...)` isn't caught, and `rm -rf "$DIR"/` with an empty variable is left to the skill.
author: nhooey/shell-skills

rules.name: pkill
rules.reason: Matches every process whose name or command line contains the pattern, the agent's own shell included. Kill the PID you started: `kill <pid>`.

rules.name: killall
rules.reason: Stops every process with that name in every session. Kill the PID you started: `kill <pid>`.

rules.name: xargs-kill
rules.reason: Kills whatever a search matched, such as whatever holds a port. Look with `lsof -i :<port>` or `pgrep -l`, then `kill <pid>` for your own process.

rules.name: rsync-delete
rules.reason: Deletes every file in the destination that isn't in the source. Sync into a fresh directory, or ask the user after showing them `rsync -n --delete`'s list.

rules.name: chmod-recursive
rules.reason: Changes permissions on a whole tree. Change the one file that needs it.

rules.name: chown-recursive
rules.reason: Changes ownership of a whole tree. Change the one file that needs it.

rules.name: brew-machine-wide
rules.reason: Changes Homebrew tools every project uses. Use the project's dev shell or `nix shell`, or ask the user.

rules.name: brew-services
rules.reason: Changes services for every session. Run the service in the foreground for the task.

rules.name: npm-global
rules.reason: Changes global npm packages or config. Use `npx` or the project's dependencies.

rules.name: nix-collect-garbage
rules.reason: Deletes store paths other projects and sessions use. Leave garbage collection to the user.

rules.name: nix-store-gc
rules.reason: Deletes store paths other projects and sessions use. Leave garbage collection to the user.

rules.name: docker-prune
rules.reason: Removes every unused container, image, volume or network, not just yours. Remove the ones you started, by id.

rules.name: launchctl-change
rules.reason: Changes launchd services for every session. Run the process in the foreground for the task, or ask the user.

rules.name: systemctl-change
rules.reason: Changes systemd services for every session. Run the process in the foreground for the task, or ask the user.

rules.name: defaults-write
rules.reason: Changes macOS settings for every program. Ask the user, or put the setting in their declarative config.
